question: List merged employee full names.

SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(e1.first_name, ' ', e1.last_name) AS full_name
FROM employees e1
JOIN employees e2 ON e1.employee_id != e2.employee_id
WHERE e1.first_name = e2.first_name AND e1.last_name = e2.last_name
ORDER BY full_name
